name: Stalking the Stalkers
summary: Huntsman Markhor, of the village of Revantusk in the Hinterlands, names the Silvermane wolves as one of the worst dangers to the village's hunters. You are asked to turn the tables and hunt the hunters.

sections.title: Wolves in Hiding
sections.body: Markhor points to the many trolls the Hinterlands wilds have already claimed, and ranks the Silvermane wolves among the greatest dangers to Revantusk's hunters. The wolves wait hidden among the bushes and the lay of the land, then pounce when the moment is right. Markhor will not let that go unanswered, and urges you to think as a Silvermane does and turn the hunt on the hunters, putting every one of them down.

sections.title: What Markhor Asks
sections.body: Markhor wants fifteen Silvermane Stalkers and fifteen Silvermane Howlers killed. Markhor adds that the wolves lurk out in the Hinterlands wilds.

sections.title: Revantusk's Thanks
sections.body: Once it is done, Markhor thanks you on behalf of the Revantusk for what you have given them.

faq.q: Who asks for the wolves to be hunted?
faq.answer: Huntsman Markhor, of the village of Revantusk in the Hinterlands.

faq.q: Why are the Silvermane wolves such a threat?
faq.answer: Markhor ranks them among the greatest dangers to Revantusk's hunters: they hide among bushes and the lay of the land and strike when the chance comes, and many trolls have already been lost out in the wilds.

faq.q: Which wolves need to be culled?
faq.answer: Fifteen Silvermane Stalkers and fifteen Silvermane Howlers.
Markhor says they lurk out in the Hinterlands wilds.

attribution: Classic quest text: Stalking the Stalkers
